Class EditMemory

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.edit.EditMemory
public final class EditMemory extends Object
The EditMemory type is the in-memory undo record for one editor. The stack remembers the text and the cursor. The caller writes text() into the live widget. The type saves nothing to disk. The span waits on a queue until undo() or redo() asks for the stack. // @aa-sdd GK-0973 aetheris-plan-f-191.001.md FINESSE:f-191 // @aa-sdd GK-0974 aetheris-plan-f-203.001.md FINESSE:f-203

  • Constructor Details

    • EditMemory

      public EditMemory()
      The constructor starts an empty line and an empty stack. The stored text is an empty string. The stored cursor is 0. The applying flag is false. The undo manager limit is LIMIT.

  • Method Details

    • applying

      public boolean applying()
      The applying method reports whether an undo or a redo is writing the stored text. The flag stays true until endApply() or until undo or redo fails.
      Returns:
      Whether an undo or a redo is writing the stored text.

    • endApply

      public void endApply()
      The endApply method clears the applying flag. The listener has applied text(). Later changes may record again.

    • text

      public String text()
      The text method returns the text the live widget should show.

    • cursor

      public int cursor()
      The cursor method returns the cursor the live widget should show. The method returns 0 when the stored cursor is negative. The method returns the text length when the stored cursor is past the end.
      Returns:
      The cursor clamped to the stored text.

    • sync

      public void sync(String text, int cursor)
      The sync method remembers this text without pushing a step. The rebuilt widget uses this method. The method stores a null text as an empty string. The method stores a negative cursor as 0. The method stores a cursor past the end as the text length.
      Parameters:
      text - The current text.
      cursor - The current cursor.

    • discard

      public void discard()
      The discard method drops the queue and the undo stack. The applying flag becomes false. text() stays until sync(String, int).

    • noteSpan

      public boolean noteSpan(int offset, String removed, String inserted, int cursorBefore, int cursorAfter)
      The noteSpan method queues one insert or one remove. The method updates the stored text and returns. The undo stack receives the span when undo() or redo() runs. The undo stack also receives the span when a later call runs fold() because redo is available or the queue holds more than LIMIT spans. cursorBefore is the caret before this change. cursorAfter is the caret after it. The method returns false when applying is true. The method treats a null removed string as empty. The method treats a null inserted string as empty. The method returns false when offset is outside the stored text. The method returns false when the removed text runs past the end. The method returns false when both the removed text and the inserted text are empty. The caret before the change is clamped to the stored text. The caret after the change is clamped to the text after the edit. The stored text becomes the prefix, the inserted text, and the suffix after the removed text.
      Parameters:
      offset - The start of the change in the text before it.
      removed - The text that left, or empty on an insert.
      inserted - The text that arrived, or empty on a remove.
      cursorBefore - The caret before the change.
      cursorAfter - The caret after the change.
      Returns:
      Whether the span was queued.

    • foldDue

      public boolean foldDue()
      The foldDue method reports whether a later call should fold the queue into the stack. The method returns true when redo is available. The method returns true when the queue holds more than LIMIT spans.
      Returns:
      Whether fold() should run.

    • fold

      public void fold()
      The fold method folds queued spans into the undo stack. The method calls drain(). The key path does not call this method.

    • drain

      private void drain()
      The drain method writes every queued span onto the undo stack. Each span is passed to addSpan(int, String, String, int, int). The queue is cleared after those writes.

    • addSpan

      private void addSpan(int at, String cut, String put, int beforeSeat, int afterSeat)
      The addSpan method pushes one span onto the undo manager. The undo step restores the removed text at at and the caret from before the change. The redo step restores the inserted text at at and the caret from after the change.
      Parameters:
      at - The start of the change.
      cut - The text that left.
      put - The text that arrived.
      beforeSeat - The caret before the change.
      afterSeat - The caret after the change.

    • note

      public void note(String text, int cursor)
      The note method records one whole-text change. The method treats a null text as an empty string. The method stores a negative cursor as 0. The method stores a cursor past the end as the text length. The method stores the text and the cursor and pushes no step when applying is true. The method stores only the cursor when the text equals the stored text. The method pushes one undo step for any other text and then stores the new text and cursor. The undo of that step restores the previous text and cursor. The redo of that step restores the text and cursor passed to this call.
      Parameters:
      text - The text after the change.
      cursor - The cursor after the change.

    • undo

      public boolean undo()
      The undo method steps back one change. The method folds the queue first through drain(). The method returns false when the stack has nothing to undo. The applying flag becomes true before the step. The caller then writes text(). The flag becomes false and the method returns false when the undo throws CannotUndoException.
      Returns:
      Whether one change was undone.

    • redo

      public boolean redo()
      The redo method steps forward one undone change. The method folds the queue first through drain(). The method returns false when the stack has nothing to redo. The applying flag becomes true before the step. The caller then writes text(). The flag becomes false and the method returns false when the redo throws CannotRedoException.
      Returns:
      Whether one change was redone.
